svg.title: The MARS agent loop: from a question, through a language model and checked tool calls, to an answer
svg.desc: A swimlane diagram in four lanes: user, MARS agent, model and validated scientific tools. A question enters from the MARS console, the Python API or the benchmark harness and becomes the conversation. The agent's model port sends the messages and tool schemas to one of 4 model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama) and receives proposed tool calls. Each call passes schema validation, an approval policy that asks a researcher before risk-tagged calls, and a repeat-call cache, then tool dispatch runs it on one of 55 tools in 5 groups (catalogs and archives, photometry and plate solving, pulsar and variable stars, hr diagrams and isochrones, radio sources); a Skynet 2 observing interface is shown as proposed. A call that fails validation or is refused returns to the conversation as an error without running. Structured results and artifact paths return from the tools to the conversation for the model's next turn, by default at most 20, and are copied on the way into the session record, which keeps the calls, arguments, outputs, decisions and artifacts. The answer and artifacts go to the console, the Python caller and the benchmark graders; answers and saved sessions inform follow-up questions.
svg.text: tool results return to the model for the next turn (default limit: 20)
